vb_textbox.text: First, try to click on each different gnome to see which ones seem to offer the highest number of mushrooms. Then keep in mind which ones tend to offer low numbers. I said the colours of the gnomes' hats out loud to remind me which ones not to click. Also occasionally there is luck involved so fon;t be put off if sometimes your "good" gnomes return very few mushrooms. Take a long term view and don't change your strategy on the strength of one selection or one poor number of mushrooms.
